articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Expanded Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially rolled out GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a larger effective context window. Benchmarks show step-function improvements on graduate-level STEM problems and complex code generation tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro Tops Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Pro, which achieved state-of-the-art scores on SWE-Bench Verified and other agentic coding evaluations, outperforming Claude and GPT-series models on multi-file repository tasks. The model introduces improved tool-use orchestration and longer reliable planning horizons, making autonomous software engineering workflows materially more practical.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Plant
articles.summary: Figure's second-generation humanoid robot, Figure 02, has entered limited commercial deployment at a BMW manufacturing facility in South Carolina, performing parts kitting and material transport tasks alongside human workers. The deployment marks one of the first revenue-generating humanoid robotics contracts and is being closely watched as a bellwether for the viability of general-purpose humanoid labor in industrial settings.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Multi-Step Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics published new research showing its electric Atlas humanoid autonomously completing complex multi-step manipulation tasks—such as sorting irregular objects and operating valves—in unstructured warehouse environments without pre-programmed routines. The system leverages a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on proprioceptive and visual data, representing a major leap in dexterous generalization for legged robots.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Persistent Memory and Sandboxed Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic shipped a major update to the Claude platform enabling persistent, long-running agents that can autonomously execute multi-step tool-use workflows with sandboxed code execution and memory across sessions. The release targets enterprise automation use cases and includes new controllability features such as human-in-the-loop checkpoints and audit logging for compliance-sensitive environments.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm A16 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its A16 (2nm-class) process node using nanosheet gate-all-around transistors has entered volume production, ahead of its originally scheduled late-2025 timeline. Early yield data reportedly exceeds expectations, which will have downstream effects on next-generation AI accelerator chips from Apple, Nvidia, and AMD expected to tape out on the node this year.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance to Expand Brain-Computer Interface Trials to Motor Restoration
articles.summary: Neuralink received expanded FDA Investigational Device Exemption clearance to enroll patients with spinal cord injuries in trials focused on restoring voluntary motor control via its N1 implant and decoder algorithms. Previous trial participants had demonstrated high-bandwidth cursor and device control; the new cohort will test closed-loop stimulation pathways aimed at re-enabling limb movement.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Maverick: A 400B MoE Model Rivaling Proprietary Frontier Systems
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Maverick, a 400-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model under a permissive open license, with benchmark performance competitive with GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro across reasoning, code, and multilingual tasks. The release includes optimized inference kernels for commodity hardware and is expected to accelerate open-source ecosystem development and enterprise on-premises AI deployment.
